I’m ready to determine the structure, but I need some experimental information about the sample. Could you please provide any of the following data (or a description of the compound)?

- ¹H NMR spectrum (chemical‑shift values, multiplicities, integration)  
- ¹³C NMR spectrum (chemical‑shift values)  
- IR spectrum (key absorption bands)  
- Mass‑spectrometry data (molecular ion m/z, fragmentation pattern)  
- A brief description of the compound (e.g., its physical state, odor, known functional groups, or any other clues)

With that information I can analyze the sample and give you the correct SMILES string.
